title: Chapter 893 Wang Yi

Chapter 893 Wang Yi

"Even if there are 100,000 pigs, it will take a few days to catch them..."

At nightfall on the first day of July, Wangyi Palace had learned about the defeat of Lantian, and there was chaos. After Hu Hai learned the news, he just stared at the wine in his hand, dumbfounded.

"But Wang Li, he was defeated so quickly. How could the black thief be so fast? Could it be that my father was really helping him..."

"His Majesty!"

Zhao Gao was so anxious that he immediately requested: "The vanguard of the thieves has left Lantian, and it only takes two days to reach Jingyang. The carriages are faster, and Xianyang and Wangyi Palace are no longer safe. Your Majesty, please patrol other places immediately!" "

The purpose of the emperor's trip to inspect the states and counties was to patrol the country, but to go on patrol at this time was to put it bluntly, to abandon the country and run away.

In fact, as early as half a month ago, after the news came that Wuguan was broken, Zhao Gao proposed:

"The late emperor patrolled prefectures and counties to show his strength and command the power of the sea. Now if Yan Ran does not patrol, he will see that he is weak, so he should not serve as a minister to the world..."

He wanted to coax Hu Hai to leave Xianyang, but Hu Hai was not mentally retarded to that extent. The soldiers on the front line were still resisting the rebels, but the emperor had fled. What kind of thing was this? Even if he did not dare to conquer in person, he would not flee, so he stopped This proposal.

But now, it's really time for him to leave!

"Where else can I go?"

Hu Hai looked up in confusion: "There is a black man in the south."

"There is Han Xin in the west. The rebels have attacked Yongdu. The old thief Li Si has also occupied Feiqiu, blocking the way to the west."

He could not return to his hometown where the Qin people were revolting, so Hu Hai could only look elsewhere hesitantly.

"There are also enemies in the northwest. It is said that Zhang Han gathered people to cause rebellion and has occupied Helan Mountain. The good families of various clans in Beidi County responded and trapped several counties."

"There are also enemies in the north, the Huns Kou Jiuyuan and Yunzhong, and the Great Wall is not defended!"

What a betrayal!

Zhao Gao was very surprised. Not to mention Heifu's side, he had tried his best to block news from the north and west. How could Hu Hai know so clearly?

Hu Hai still trusted Zhao Gao and said: "This is all what the guard ordered Pu She to tell us!"

Zhao Gao secretly hated that the guard order Pushe was Hu Hai's personal attendant since he became the son of the prince. He was also the only person he could not get rid of so far. Hu Hai always stayed in the guard palace with him.

But now there is no time to eliminate dissidents. Seeing that Hu Hai is still motionless, Zhao Gao immediately kowtows:

"Your Majesty, there is still another place to go!"

"Where?" Hu Hai seemed to grasp a life-saving straw.

Zhao Gao said: "Dongfang, Xian Gong's old capital is Yueyang! My younger brother Zhao has become the governor of Hedong. Although there are rebellions in various places, Hedong is still safe. Your Majesty, why not go to Yueyang first, then enter the West River, cross Puban or Longmen, and patrol Hedong... "

"Just follow the Prime Minister, follow the Prime Minister..." Hu Hai nodded. Just when Zhao Gao was about to go down to make preparations, he remembered something.

"Prime Minister."

"What else does your Majesty have to do?"

Hu Hai looked at the east and said, "On the way to Yueyang, do we have to pass through Gaoling County?"

"I'm passing by." Zhao Gao had a bad feeling.

Sure enough, after hesitating for a long time, Hu Hai murmured: "Are the young masters and princesses who were previously detained in Gaoling County still alive?"

After Li Si, Jiang Lu and other three princes rebelled and fled, Zhao Gao took the opportunity to slander and ordered Hu Hai to seize the princes and princesses and imprison them in Gaoling County, ready to kill them at any time, in order to fulfill the secret agreement with the Chu army to destroy the Qin clan.

But now, there was regret in Hu Hai's eyes!

"When we pass Gaoling County, we will release them..."

"Your Majesty, why...why do you want to release the traitor?"

When a person is about to die, his words are also kind. When the building is about to collapse, Hu Hai seems to have a sudden change of nature, crying and saying:

"The thief is approaching and coming with ferocity. Even if I hunt eastward, I may not be able to escape. Although I have many concubines, I still have no children. Heifu is bent on usurping us, and he will definitely join the Qin clan."

"If I kill the young masters again, won't I help him cut off his father's bloodline? Let me distribute some gold and silk and let my brothers and sisters escape for their lives. The world is so big, there is always a place to hide... "

"His Majesty……"

Zhao Gaoyi was frustrated and seemed about to have an attack, but after looking around, he finally swallowed his breath and smiled again: "Your Majesty is wise and kind, and you still have filial piety and brotherhood in mind even now. I will do it now!"

After Zhao Gao left, Hu Haiku sat in the palace. Looking up, he could see the glorious roof of the palace. After leaving the house, he could see the brightly lit Xianyang City on the other side of the Jing River from the corridor. The former First Emperor was in Guanzhong. Daying Palace, Xianyang Palace in Xianyang Beiban symbolizes the Ziwei Star where the Emperor of Heaven lives. The Wei River is like the Milky Way. The Emperor of Heaven can go out from Tianji, that is, the Ji Temple, pass through the pavilion, cross the Tianhe River, and reach Ziwei Palace and Afang Palace...

Looking out at Wangyi Palace at this moment, it really feels like looking at the Milky Way from afar.

"Who owns this beautiful palace?"

"Beautiful palace and room, no one else can have it!"

Recalling that the grace and enjoyment that he had enjoyed for so long would no longer exist in one day, and he was as panic-stricken as a bereaved dog, Hu Hai felt so sad that he couldn't cut it off, so he howled and burst into tears.

But before he could grieve, he suddenly heard a commotion outside, and an eunuch hurriedly came to report: "Your Majesty, the thief has arrived, the thief has arrived!"

Hu Hai was immediately stunned: "Didn't the traitor just come out of Lantian? Why did he arrive so soon!"

"His Majesty!"

A powerful voice sounded, and a warrior wearing thick armor and holding a halberd came up to the temple and bowed down:

"Zhou's house is carefully guarded to prevent thieves from entering the palace. The person causing trouble outside is not the thieves, but Zhao Gao. He and a group of close followers want to enter the palace and kidnap Your Majesty!"

"What!" Hu Hai felt like he was struck by lightning. Although everyone was betrayed and separated from his relatives, he still had the three most trusted people.

Wei Ling Pu She, clan brother Zi Ying, and number one is the teacher Zhao Gao.

But now Wei Ling Pu She said that Zhao Gao deceived him and wanted to rebel?

This was enough to defeat Hu Hai.

Hu Hai shook his head like a rattle: "I don't believe it, I don't believe it! The Prime Minister wants to protect me when I hunt in the east!"

"The east side is absolutely unreachable!" Wei Ling Pu She revealed the truth: "The east side of the river has been occupied by bandits from the Six Nations!"

Hu Hai still didn't believe it: "But the Prime Minister clearly said that there is peace in the east of the river."

The guard ordered his servant to shoot: "That thief was brought in by Zhao Gao! I heard that Zhao Gao was afraid of the black man, so he asked his brother, Hedong Wei Zhao Cheng, to let go of Guanjin and allow the Six Nations group to invade the county, and even wanted to lure them in. Guan! Now he is persuading Your Majesty to go to Hedong. He actually wants to hand Your Majesty over to the hands of the Six Nations in exchange for wealth and life!"

Hu Hai was completely confused and could fit a duck egg in his mouth: "The Prime Minister is loyal to me, how could he be like this?"

"The thief has arrived in front of the palace!"

But there was no time to think. There were noisy exclamations outside again. The guard ordered Pushe to grit his teeth, lowered his head and said:

"Please rest in peace, Your Majesty. I will go and kill the thief right now! After killing the Zhao thief, I will protect Your Majesty and go to Shangjun!"

The guard ordered Pu She to turn around and leave. There was a sound of fighting and fighting outside, but Hu Hai could only tremble and huddle in front of His Majesty, and said blankly:

"Master, how could you lie to your disciple?"

After the sound of fighting outside subsided, messy footsteps were heard, but a group of fully armed soldiers came up to the temple in a menacing manner. The leader was Zhao Gao. Behind him, his cronies were holding a bloody head, which seemed to be the servants of the guards. cum...

Zhao Gao knelt down from afar and said: "Your Majesty, the servant of the guard wanted to rebel, took refuge with the black thieves, and allowed the thieves to enter Wangyi Palace without stopping. I had no choice but to kill him, which frightened Your Majesty!"

"Please Your Majesty, please immediately leave the palace with me to hunt east! If you don't leave, it will be too late!"

Hu Hai looked around and saw that the palace was empty. Zhao Gao's party was all in front of him, except for a young eunuch who served him every day. He was trembling and did not dare to escape.

"Who should I trust?"

Hu Hai murmured: "I'm not going anywhere, I'm right here at Wangyi Palace..."

Hei Fu was getting closer and closer, and Zhao Gao had already lost his patience and said, "The matter is urgent, but your Majesty cannot help it!"

After saying this, he waved his hands, and all the cronies stepped forward like wolves and tigers to hold down Hu Hai's hands and feet, dragging him out of Wangyi Palace. Along the way were the corpses of the guards who died in the hard battle with the guards, and even more The rebels chased the palace maids and concubines, but no one stopped them...

Hu Hai suddenly remembered something and exclaimed: "Master, Master Zhao, take the queen and my concubines with you..."

Zhao Gao turned around and said with a sullen face: "Now that the matter has come to this, there is no time to care about them!"

Hu Hai suddenly understood. He looked at Zhao Gao again. For a moment, this familiar and kind Master Zhao turned out to be so strange and so hateful!

Hu Hai tried to resist. For a moment, the crown on his head was crooked and the skirt of his clothes was torn:

"Let me go, I order you, I am the emperor of Qin, the second emperor!"

However, this title has no effect at this moment. When the power is no longer, the emperor is just a ridiculous weakling, and those Zhao Gao's disciples squeeze him tighter.

After leaving the Wangyi Palace, they saw a long line of carriages and horses outside. Hu Hai was stuffed into a carriage like a little chicken, and was about to be taken away by force when he heard a neighing sound from outside!

Everyone looked back and saw a group of military chariots approaching fiercely at the gate of Wangyi Palace. They rushed past the more than a thousand cronies arranged by Zhao Gao and broke out.

In the leading car, there was a middle-aged young man in a formal dress, holding a sword and a gun, glaring at Zhao Gao!

"Traitor Zhao Gao, how dare you attempt to murder His Majesty!?"
